WITH order_requirements AS (
    SELECT order_id, product_id, SUM(qty) as order_qty
    FROM picking_line
    GROUP BY order_id, product_id
),
inventory_totals AS (
    SELECT product_id, SUM(qty) as total_inv
    FROM inventory
    GROUP BY product_id
),
order_fulfillment AS (
    SELECT 
        or_.order_id,
        or_.product_id,
        or_.order_qty,
        COALESCE(it.total_inv, 0) as total_inv,
        CASE 
            WHEN or_.order_qty <= COALESCE(it.total_inv, 0) THEN or_.order_qty
            ELSE it.total_inv
        END as picked_qty
    FROM order_requirements or_
    LEFT JOIN inventory_totals it ON or_.product_id = it.product_id
)
SELECT 
    p.name as product_name,
    ROUND(AVG(OF.picked_qty * 100.0 / OF.order_qty), 2) as avg_pick_pct
FROM order_fulfillment OF
JOIN products p ON OF.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.name
ORDER BY p.name
